fields.Name: T262 - Knowledge Analytics Co-occurrence Recompute
fields.Description: Exercises the idempotent co-occurrence aggregation recompute (RecomputeCoOccurrence) — a distinct server aggregation refresh separate from the KPI/drilldown reads.

InputDefinition.goal: In the Knowledge Hub 'Analytics' screen (via application switcher then Analytics), open the 'Tags' section and scroll to the 'Frequently Paired Tags' (co-occurrence) sub-section. Click the 'Recompute' button. Success is that the recompute is accepted — the button shows a 'Computing…' spinner/disabled state and afterward the co-occurrence table populates with tag pairs, OR a 'No co-occurrence data' empty state remains. You do NOT need any particular data. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Analytics Tags section shows a 'Frequently Paired Tags' area with a Recompute button
Clicking Recompute enters a Computing/disabled state and then shows the co-occurrence table or a valid empty state
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
